title: Many devices have no primary user

maxPct.text: Share without a primary user before support and licensing suffer

messages.businessImpact: Nobody can be contacted about the device, user-targeted policy does not reach it, and self-service actions such as key retrieval do not work.
remediation: Set the primary user on shared or kiosk devices deliberately, or accept them as an exception and exclude them.
messages.cannotSee: A device Intune holds no primary user for is reported, whether that is deliberate or not: a shared, kiosk or lab machine legitimately has none, and this cannot tell one from an oversight.
